name: InboxAlly
summary: Email deliverability tool that trains your sender reputation: engagement-based signals keep your campaigns and cold outreach out of spam and in the primary inbox — works alongside any ESP or email platform.
best_for: serious senders — email marketers and cold-outreach teams — whose deliverability problems are costing measurable revenue and who need active reputation repair
skip_if: you're a small sender who just needs basic list hygiene (cheaper warm-up tools suffice), or your inbox issues stem from content and list quality you haven't fixed
honest_knock: This is a premium, seed-list-based deliverability tool, and the price reflects it — Starter alone is well above casual warm-up apps, so it only makes sense if inbox placement is genuinely costing you real revenue. It improves sender reputation through engagement signals, but it's not a magic fix for bad content or a purchased list: deliverability still depends on how you actually send. Buy it when the math (lost revenue from spam-foldering) clearly beats the monthly fee.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (price re-verified 2026-08-31 against the vendor's own pricing page, read from a European exit, and unchanged on 2026-09-29) Every amount unchanged and confirmed on the plan comparison table, which states 'Pricing in USD, billed monthly': Starter $149/mo (100 seed emails/day, 1 sender profile), Plus $645/mo (500/day, 5 profiles), Premium $1,190/mo (1,000/day, 10 profiles), Enterprise custom (custom volume, unlimited profiles, dedicated deliverability experts). 10-day free trial, no card. No annual billing option is offered. Premium's sessions, more precisely than the previous dossier: a 1-hour setup/strategy session plus weekly 30-minute progress reviews. VENDOR SELF-CONTRADICTION, confirm before relying: the tier cards give Starter 'Email support' and reserve live chat for Plus and above, while the comparison table lower on the same page ticks 'Live chat support' and 'Dedicated CSM' for all four tiers including Starter. Phone & Zoom support, the setup session and the weekly reviews are consistently Premium-and-above in both places. Every plan includes IA Score, IA Reputation, Adaptive Autowarmup, the in-app IA Assistant, the full REST API, native CRM integrations and inbox placement testing. Re-read 2026-09-29: the page's own FAQ now goes further than either, saying email, live chat, phone and Zoom support are 'all standard' and a dedicated CSM is assigned on every plan, while the cards and the table still keep Phone & Zoom for Premium and above. The same FAQ says full reputation repair typically takes 4 to 8 weeks, so the 10-day trial is for judging fit rather than completing a warm-up.
